strategies.name: Fused bidiagonal computation buffers
strategies.desc: Pre-allocate and reuse two ping-pong buffers to eliminate redundant memory allocation across stages; all coupling/decoupling operations write to alternating buffers before all-reduce. Still 8 all-reduce dispatches but reduces memory bandwidth overhead by ~40% through buffer reuse and better cache locality.

strategies.name: Reduce-scatter then all-gather pattern
strategies.desc: Decompose each all-reduce into reduce-scatter (producing local shard) + all-gather phases; perform bidiagonal coupling only on locally-owned shard boundaries during scatter phase, then gather. Increases dispatch count to 16 (2 per stage) but reduces per-dispatch payload by factor of world_size for reduce-scatter, trading latency for bandwidth.

strategies.name: Hierarchical two-level collective reduction
strategies.desc: Exploit 224 = 8 nodes × 28 devices structure by first performing intra-node all-reduce (28-way), applying bidiagonal transform on node-local intermediate results, then inter-node all-reduce (8-way). Total 16 dispatches (8 stages × 2 levels) but each operates on smaller groups, potentially hiding node-crossing latency.

strategies.name: Pipelined overlapped stage execution
strategies.desc:
Split full tensor into independent chunks and pipeline stages so that stage i+1 begins on chunk k while stage i processes chunk k+1; use async all-reduce dispatches with explicit barrier synchronization only at chunk boundaries. Maintains 8 logical stages but overlaps communication and local compute across chunks to hide latency.
